# VeilPix - AI Image and Video Generator

## Overview
VeilPix is a free-to-try, privacy-focused AI image and video workspace for photo editing, text-to-image creation, and multimodal AI video generation.

## Key Facts
- Free tier: 30 credits after sign-up
- Featured video model: Wan 3.0 Standard (lower cost) and Prime (faster)
- Wan 3.0 inputs: text, first/last frames, up to 10 images, 5 videos, 5 audio files, a document, or a public webpage
- Wan 3.0 output: 2-30 seconds, 480P/720P/1080P, adaptive or fixed aspect ratios, optional audio, and reproducible seeds
- Other video models: Seedance 2.5 and earlier Wan workflows
- Image models: Nano Banana 2, Seedream 5 Lite/Pro, and Z-Image Turbo
- Privacy: browser-local Albums, no public creation feed, and a private account-scoped delivery copy available to signed-in browsers for up to 48 hours before deletion; provider retention applies

## Wan 3.0 Workflows
1. Text-to-Video - Describe a scene without references
2. Start/End Frames - Define an exact opening frame and optional closing frame
3. Multimodal References - Guide motion, characters, style, sound, and composition with images, videos, and audio
4. File-to-Video - Ground a clip in a supported document
5. Link-to-Video - Use a publicly accessible webpage as context
6. Standard Mode - Lower-cost generation with the complete workflow set
7. Prime Mode - Faster generation with the same input modes

## Other Features
- AI photo editing, retouching, filters, adjustments, and multi-image composition
- Seedance 2.5 multimodal clips up to 30 seconds with MP4 or MOV output
- Last-frame continuation and browser-side video stitching
- Browser-local Album with temporary delivery recovery instead of a persistent server-side creative gallery
